rows.grounds: compound adjective describing beings whose lives are lost to snakes and similar dangers
compound adjective describing beings torn by elephants and tigers

items.question: Which beings whose lives are lost to snakes and who are torn by elephants or tigers are included among the eligible?
items.inference: The verse extends eligibility to those killed by dangerous animals.
uncertainties: Exact ritual referent of the listed beings is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: Those whose lives are lost to snakes and the like, and those torn by elephants and tigers, are indeed included.
